verdict.rationale: 2FAS is a local-first 2FA authenticator, password manager and encrypted-sharing tool. Scheduling recurring jobs or workflows is a workflow-automation capability outside this product category. Nothing in the evidence shows 2FAS ships any job scheduler. Share's link expiration is a one-off security setting, not a recurring schedule, and the llms.txt probe declares 'Public API: None'.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
